trustBoundary.before: Verified source semantics -> LeanDSP stack IR; IR -> textual WAT was unproved.
trustBoundary.now: Verified source semantics -> stack IR -> typed WasmSubset expression/block semantics. Remaining compiler boundary begins at typed WasmSubset -> textual WAT pretty-printing/helper WAT definitions, followed by WABT and the WebAssembly engine.

notes: The typed subset explicitly represents constants, logical local/global references, unary/binary/compare operations, select, buffer taps, ordered bind/store/push, and output.
Scalar semantics remain parametric; the proof does not claim approximate sin/exp helpers equal real-number functions.
The JavaScript host scheduler, mixer, effects routing and browser engine remain outside this theorem.
